description:
0.87.0: sign a file as it is now. Your signature is written into a block at the end of the file
        (`<!-- hashn:signatures -->`, one line per party), saved as you. What you sign is the content: every byte
        above that block. When every party the file names has signed the same content, it is agreed and goes into
        hashn's log (list_agreements) with what it refers to; an edit above the block makes it a draft again and
        the signatures there stop counting. Only a party signs (`parties`, or the dimension the file's convention
        names with `agreed_by`). Under `refers_to` the file says what it is tied to: each member is a relationship
        (`supersedes`, `outcome`, ...), its value the thing: `{ref: <workspace_id>/<path>, sha256: <the file's
        SHA-256 now>}`, `{ref: <workspace_id>/<folder>/}` or `{agent: <id>}`. hashn checks each SHA-256 when you sign
        and refuses if the file referred to has changed (`reference_changed` gives the one it has now).

api_token.description: Your hashn API token, if you can't send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. Omit it when the header is set.
api_token.title: Api Token

path.description: A file path inside the workspace, like 'drafts/report.md'. Folders are just '/' in the path.
path.title: Path

workspace_id.description: The workspace's id (a UUID), from create_workspace, list_workspaces or the store.
workspace_id.title: Workspace Id

name: sign
